tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// chos 'chad nyan bya tshul dang*/ dbang bskur rjes gnang sogs kyi rnam dbye blo dman nyams dga' zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma yi dam dbyer med la// lus kyi 'khri shing rab btud nas// dam chos 'chad nyan bya tshul dang*// dbang rjes dbye ba mdor bsdus bri// de la'ang gnyis las/ dang po chos 'chad nyan ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ thog mar phyag dang yon dbul ba ni/ bla ma de sangs rgyas kun 'dus su mos la/ de'i spyan sngar lus zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam par blos sprul nas sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal ba'o// yon dbul ba ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis rim pa lnga par/ de nyid mi zad 'dod pa yis// sogs gsungs te/ de nyid ces pas bsgrub bya bstan/ des rang dang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa mi zad pa thob par 'dod pa des bla ma la yon 'bul dgos shing*/ dbul rgyu'ang rang la gces shing phangs la yid du 'ong ba rnams 'bul dgos te/ ches khyad yid 'ong 'phags pa nyid// de dang de ni bla mar 'bul// ces dang*/ ches khyad par du 'phags shing*/ gtang dka' bu dang chung ma nas rang gi srog gi bar gyis mnyes par bya dgos pa yin te/ sbyin dka' bu dang chung ma dang*// rang gi srog kyang gtang bya na// longs spyod g.yo ba smos ci dgos// zhes gsungs so// de'i 'thad pa rim lnga'i 'grel pa nor bu'i phreng bar/ gang gis bskal pa bye ba ni// brgya phrag tu yang rnyed dka' ba'i// sangs rgyas nyid kyang bcom ldan la// tshe 'di nyid la ster bar byed// ces gsungs te/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo tshogs gnyis yin la/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyang bsod nams kyi tshogs las skye bar 'gyur zhing*/ bsod nams bsags pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo bla ma mnyes par bya ba yin te/ gsang ba 'dus par/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang mnyam pa la bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dang mnyam par bsnyen bkur ba las/

gang gis rdo rje slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig la snum gyis byug pa byas pa'ang ches bsod nams khyad par 'phags so// zhes sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' grangs de snyed la yun de tsam du mchod cing bsnyen bkur pa las/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon la zhabs tog gi bsam pas ba spu'i bu gar snum gyis byug pa khyad par 'phags pa sogs sgrub phyogs kyi lugs bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ dgag pa'i phyogs kyang rdo rje gur las/ gang gis bla mar gsol ma btab// de ni rigs su skye ba med// ces bla mar gsol ba ma btab pa'am/ btab kyang khas ma blangs na chos 'di'i rigs su ma skyes pa zhes bya/ sgom sgrub nyan bshad gang byas kyang ji lta ba mi 'byung bar ngal ba don med du 'gyur ba las gsol ba gdab pa gal che'o// de ltar dpon slob 'dus nas 'chad nyan byed pa'i thog mar chos nyan pa'i kun tu spyod pa gsal gdab pa zhes bya ba bstan par bya'o// de'ang*/ mdun du dul bar 'dug pa dang*// gos sogs tshul ni bsdam pa dang*// pus btsugs thal mo sbyar byas nas// nyan sogs 'dod pas gsol gsum gdab// ces gsungs pa ltar/ spyir chos nyan pa'i lus kyi kun tu spyod pa ni/ bla ma'i mdun gyi drang thad du bsdad par bya ba yin gyi/ rgyab dang glo sogs su mi sdod/ khyad par zur thad du 'dug na bar chad mang bas spang bar bya zhing*/ ci ste stabs kyis ma 'khyud par glo la sogs su sdod dgos pa byung na'ang mdun du yod pa'i bsam pa bya/ lus drang por bsrang ste cung zad 'dud pa dang bcas pa las/ phan tshun snyes pa dang nyal ba/ mgo g.yogs pa dang*/ lag pas 'gram pa brten pa dang*/ gdugs dang mtshon cha thogs pa sogs ma gus pa'i spyod lam thams cad spangs shing*/ lus gnad dwangs sing nge ba re bcas pas rgyud la byin rlabs myur du skye ba'i rten 'brel yod pa yin na/ sems kyi bsam pa ni mdo las/

legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung shig dang*/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ legs par nyan pa ni snod kha sbub kyi skyon spang ba ste/ de'ang dper na dbyar gyi dus char gyi rgyun drag tu 'bab pa'i sar snod kha cig kha sbubs nas bzhag na/ lo zla bar nyin mtshan bar ma chad par ji tsam 'babs kyang snod de'i nang du zegs ma gcig kyang 'gro bar mi nus pa bzhin du/ chos nyan pa'i tshe gnyid rmugs sam/ shes pa rgya yan du btang nas chos gral du bsdad na/ chos ji tsam bshad kyang rgyud la 'jags pa'am/ de na la brin rgyu til 'bru tsam yang med par rna bar chu sgra shang nge ba zer ba de yong la/ de lta bu'i chos nyan lo zlar byas kyang phan yon cung zad med pa'i khar chos la brten pa'i nyes pa du ma yod pas chos nyan pa'i tshe shes pa gzhan la yid ma yengs par byas la/ chos de'i tshig don la gzhig yid la gang 'jags bya ste snod kha sbubs pa lta bu'i skyon spang*/ de bzhin du rab tu nyon ces gsungs pa'i don snod dri ma can gyi skyon spang ste/ dper na snod kha slong ba rkyang pas mi chog de'i nang du dug gam mi gtsang ba nas tha na du ba'am thal ba'i bar gang yod kyang*/ de dag ma bsal bar chu nas bdud rtsi'i bar gyi bcud gang blugs kyang srog 'phrog pa'i nad skyed pa sogs 'byung bas bcud de'ang chud zos par 'gyur la/ de dag phyir bsal nas bdud rtsi'i bar gyi bcud gang blugs de dang de'i bya ba skyon med du byed nus pa ltar/ chos kyi tshig don blo yul du 'jags pa tsam gyis mi chog gi/ chos nyan pa'i bsam pa bdag gis chos 'di nyan la/ rang mi dga' ba 'di lta bu zhig dma' dbab par bya'o snyam pa lta bu zhe sdang gis kun nas bslangs pa dang*/ yul phyogs 'di 'dra zhig tu chos 'di 'dra zhig btsongs nas rnyed pa bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa ste 'dod chags kyi dang*/ rang gi 'gran zlar gyur pa rnams las lhag pa zhig bya'o snyam pa lta bu nga rgyal dang phrag dog ste/

mdor na dug gsum gyi bsam pas kun nas bslangs pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum gang byas rung*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// zhes gsungs pas/ 'phral dge ba ltar snang yang phug ngan song kho nar nges par 'grub par byed pas na/ sems kyi kun slong ngan pa thams cad bsrings te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi lhag pa'i bsam pas zin par byas la dri can gyi skyon spang bar bya/ de bzhin du/ yid la zung zhig ces pa'i don snod zhabs rdol gyi skyon spang dgos te/ dper na zhabs rdol pa'am gas pa lta bu der bcud ji tsam blugs kyang phyir bud nas nang du cung zad kyang mi chags pa bzhin du/ chos nyan pa'i tshig don rnams bsam bzhin yid la ma brjed par ma bzung na bar bshad pa na mgo brjed/ mjug bshad tsa na bar brjed/ chos grwa nas langs pa dang tshig don 'di'o zhes brjod du yod pa lta ci smos/ ming tsam yang bshad rgyu med pa zhig 'byung bas/ dran 'dzin chen pos yang dang yang du bskyar te ji srid nyams su ma myong gi bar du nam yang brjed pa med par yid la gsal ba zhig gal che/ de bzhin du slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis rnam bshad rig par/ nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang*// don du mi gnyer ba nyid dang*// phyi rol rnam g.yeng yid bsdus dang*// skyo ba nyan pa'i dri ma yin// ces gsungs te/ nga rgyal gyi chos nyan pa ni bla ma las rang nyid rigs lang tsho thos pa la sogs pa khyad par 'phags mod/ 'on kyang chos 'di thob pa'i phyir tsam du nyan lo bya snyam pas nyan pa de ni shin tu nyes pa che bas/ bdag nyid la nad pa/ bla ma la sman pa'i 'du shes bzhag ste shin tu gus pa'i sgo nas nyan/ ma dad dang zhes pa ni chos dang bla ma la dad pa til 'bru tsam med kyang gang skad zer ram/ chos ci 'dra zhig yod dam snyam du skyon rtog pa kho na la chas pa ste/ deng sang gi mi skor dgu skor/

ma thos dgu thos pa 'di chos 'di mang ngo nyung ngo*// bla ma ni ma sbyangs so// mi mkhas po 'di'i thad du chog nor/ nyog nor zhes smra ba/ dge bshes bka' gdams pa rnams kyi gsung sgros las/ slog gsham drud pa zhes slog pa ring po zhig srang mdo rnams su drud nas phyin na/ gser dngul sogs dngos po dag pa rnams ni gcig kyang mi 'byar la/ mi gtsang ba dang sbar sbur sogs ngan pa thams cad 'jus yong ba bzhin/ bla ma dang chos kyi yon tan nam yang mi mthong la/ skyon cung zad tsam yang ched 'dzin byed pa de lta bus ni bskal par chos nyan kyang phan yon til 'bru tsam yang mi 'byung ba'i khar chos la brten pa'i las ngan tshabs po che bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsog pa yin pas/ bla mas snang tshul ji ltar ston kyang nga rang gi snang ba ma dag pa yin/ bla ma la ma legs sogs pa ga la mnga' snyam du dad pa bskyed/ chos kyang rgyas bsdus gang yod kyang bde bar gshegs pa gdul bya thams cad kyi bsam pa dang mthun par chos gsungs pa yin gyi/ bdag gcig po la dgongs te gsungs pa ga la yin/ de bas na rang gi yid la mi babs kyang de dang des 'dul ba'i gdul bya gzhan du ma yod pas/ gang la ci dga' bar chos ston pa ngo mtshar snyam du dad pa cher bskyed/ don du mi gnyer ba nyid dang zhes pa ni chos nyan pa na zhor chos sam/ khral lta bu ma gtogs chos la don du gnyer ba'i blo med par gal chung chos dang*/ gal che shos 'phral gyi brel spyod la byas nas chos thun gyi mgo mjug shor ba'am/ thun ril por chag kyang sems dogs gang yang med par phangs med du skyur 'jog pa de 'dra'ang byar mi nyan pas/ chos de tshugs nas ma grol gyi bar du gzhan thams cad cam gyis bzhag la/ bsam rgyu chos de las med pa cig bya/ phyi rol rnam g.yeng zhes pa chos grwa der sleb pa na dbang po drug yul la rgya yan du btang ste res khang pa'i gdung rtsa na yar lta rtog

res bzhad sgros dang bzhad gad/ de lta bu ma yin na'ang 'og 'gyur rgya 'byams pa'i ngang las chos grol ba de ngo shes pa de lta bur byar mi nyan pas sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig tu dril nas nyan par byed/ yid bsdus dang zhes pa 'ga' zhig rgyun du dge sbyor la do gal med kyang*/ chos grwa der sleb pa na kho sgom bzang du song nas chos la rna ba mi gtod par mnyam gzhag byed pa dang*/ la la mun chen gnyid log lta bu yid nang du bsdus nas chos kyi tshig don la yid mi gtod pa lta bu spangs te/ rna ba blags te nyan par byed do// skyo ba nyan pa'i dri ma yin// ces pas skyo ba la mi shes pas skyo ba ni/ las dang po pa 'ga' zhig ji tsam 'bad nas nyan blo byas kyang tshig don ji lta ba go bar ma nus pas skyo ste/ shes ni mi shes par 'dug ste/ nga rang nyan nas ci byed/ gzhag gam snyam pa'i blo shar na/ de 'dra ci zhig dgos/ mi shes pas ka nyan dgos pa yin gyi/ shes na nyan pa la dgos pa med do// grub zin sgrub pa dang mtshungs/ des na yang dang yang du nyan pas go ba je drag je drag la song nas mthar tshig don thams cad rang dbang thob pa zhig 'byung bas/ ched du 'bad cing nyan par byed/ thun che pas skyo ba ni/ 'ga' zhig chos thun ches pa na de nyan mi nus par/ da gang byed/ grol na dga' ste snyam pa'i rtog pa 'char bas/ chos thun ches pa la skyon ci yod/ sngon gyi dus su thub pa'i dbang po rgyal por 'khrungs pa na/ yul der chos kyi sgra mi grag cing*/ rgyal po sngon gyi bag chags sad nas chos don du gnyer bar gyur te/ chos tshig bzhi pa gcig gi don du sku lus la mar me stong btsugs te chos gsan pa lta bu dka' ba du mas chos btsal ba'i tshod na/ rang re rnams 'bad med du dam pa'i chos nyan chog pa bskal ba dpag tu med pa nas bsod nams bsags pa yin la/ de bzhin du sngon dge slong zhig gis nel kha zhig na chos ston pa na/

de'i nye 'khor gyi rdzing bu zhig na gnas pa'i sbal pa zhig kyang der thon nas chos kyi sgra rna bar lhang nge thos pa'i ngang la/ gnag rdzi dga' bo zhes pas mkhar ba btsugs pa'i rkyen gyis sbal pa shi ste/ chos kyi sgra thos bzhin du shi ba'i phan yon gyis gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lhar skyes pa dang*/ dge slong zhig rgyun du mdo sdud pa zhal 'don du mdzad pa'i brang khang gi gdung khang na thi ba zhig nyal kyin yod pa tshe'i dus byas nas mdo thos pa'i phan yon gyis mi lus thob/ chos sgor zhugs nas thi ba'i dus kyi gang thos pa yan chad kyi mdo bslab ma dgos par shes pa lta bur dud 'gros chos kyi don go ba med kyang sgra thos pa tsam la'ang phan yon de lta bu yod na/ chos kyi sgra thos/ don go na phan yon chen po yod pa lta ci smos/ des na 'di lta bu'i chos nyan du yod pa bskal pa du ma nas bsod nams bsags pa yin snyam du yid la dran par byed/ de ltar skyon drug spangs te 'du shes lnga'i sgo nas chos nyan par byed/ de'ang bla ma la sman pa/ bdag nyid la nad pa/ chos la sman/ nyams su len pa la nad nye bar gso ba/ grogs la nad g.yog gi 'du shes bskyed de nyan par bya dgos so// gnyis pa dbang dang byin rjes sogs kyi dbye ba la bzhi las/ dang po la/ dbang zhes bya ba ni rgyud sde'i dgongs pa slob dpon rnams kyis bkral ba'i sbyong smin gyi thabs khyad par can te/ de la'ang dbye bsdu mang du mchis pa las/ dbye sgo thams cad kyi gtso bo ni rgyud sde bzhir bzhed pa'i phyogs te bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ bla med do// dang po bya rgyud kyi rnam gzhag la spyi'i don dang*/ dbang bskur tshul gnyis las/ dang po la/ bya ba spyi'i rgyud dang*/ so so'i rgyud gnyis las/ spyi'i rgyud ni ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i thabs dbang bskur ba'i skor gtso bor ston pa gsang ba spyi'i rgyud dang*/

legs grub kyi rgyud dang*/ dpung bzang gi rgyud dang*/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud rnams dang*/ so so'i rgyud la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs gnyis/ snga ma la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ pad+ma'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs gsum mchog 'bring tha ma'i tshul du gnas la/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs la nor can gyi rigs/ lngas rtsen gyi rigs/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs te gsum yod do// de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la rigs kyi gtso bo/ rigs kyi bdag po/ rigs kyi yum/ rigs kyi gtsug tor/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo/ rigs kyi pho nya bka' nyan/ rigs kyi byang sems/ rigs kyi lha klu gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i gzugs rnams la brten nas bod gangs can 'dir bkral tshul mang yang*/ rang lugs ni ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi bya rgyud spyi rnam las/ bya ba'i rgyud 'di rgyud sde thams cad kyi gzhi ma yin pa'i phyir/ rgyud sde gong mas dbang byas pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ bya rgyud rang gi lugs ltar bkral ba la sogs 'phags yul gyi slob dpon rnams kyis lugs mi 'dra ba du ma zhig mdzad pa rnams phan tshun lugs bsres pa'i grub mtha' gzhag tu mi rung gi/ so so'i lugs bzhin bshad par bya ba la bzhi/ bya rgyud bla med ltar bshad pa/ rnal 'byor rgyud ltar bshad pa/ spyod rgyud ltar bshad pa/ bya rgyud rang lugs ltar bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis spyan ras gzigs phyag stong pa'i sgrub thabs las/ cho ga gsum gyis bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs 'khor bcas su bskyed/ de la ye shes pa spyan drang zhing gzhug dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa rnams bshad la/ 'di rnal 'byor chen po ltar bkral bar mngon te/ sgrub thabs de nyid las/ de nas rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom par bya ste/ zab pa dang phra ba'i rdzogs rim ni bla ma'i man ngag las shes par bya'o// zhes byung la/

bya rgyud rang dbang can yin na bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi tha snyad gtan med pa'i phyir ro// de bzhin du slob dpon a bha yās rdo rje phreng bar/ grwa lnga dang 'od zer can la sogs bshad pa rnams kyang rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs yin te/ dkyil 'khor de rnams la bskyed tshul rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor du bshad la/ bya rgyud la de'i tha snyad ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro// de bzhin du sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang*/ phyed dang nyis brgya pa dang*/ brgya rtsa rnams su bshad pa'i bya rgyud kyi lha'i sgrub thabs rnams dang*/ slob dpon dze tā ri'i grwa lnga'i sgrub thabs sogs gzhung chung phal che ba rnams rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs ltar bkral bar shes par bya'o// des na slob dpon de rnams kyi bzhed pas dam tshig gsum bkod sogs so so'i rgyud nas dngos bstan du bshad pa'i sha chang spang ba sogs rnams ni de las gzhan du mi 'chad kyang*/ der mi gsal ba dang ma tshang ba kha bskang dgos pa rnams bya ba spyi'i rgyud bzhis kha mi skong bar bla med kyi rgyud kho nas kha bskangs pa yin te/ lugs 'di bzhed pa'i rgya gar ba'i slob dpon shin tu mang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel par/ slob dpon kun snying gis/ bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ gnyis ka'i rgyud la sogs pa'i cho ga la mngon par zhen pa rnams kyis kyang cho ga des 'di las bshad pa'i phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa bsgrub par bya'o// zhes don de bshad par bya ba'i phyir/ snying po phyag rgya sngags rig rnams// ji ltar 'dod pa'i tshul gyis ni// zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i tshul gyi ston to// zhes gsungs so// de'i don rnal 'byor rgyud nas gsungs pa'i cho gas bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud la sbyar du rung bar gsungs la/ ji ltar sbyor tshul ni/ rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa bar/ rnal 'byor rnam gsum shes bya ste// byin gyis brlabs dang yongs brtags dang*// gzugs nyid rdzogs par gyur pa ni// rnal 'byor yin zhes sangs rgyas gsungs// zhes rnal 'byor gsum gsungs la/

de'i dang po byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bya ba'i rgyud la sbyar bar bya ba'i sgrub thabs su bshad de/ rgyud de'i 'grel par/ slob dpon kun snying gis/ byin gyis brlabs ces pa ni nye bar mtshon pa tsam ste/ des na dbang bskur ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ zhes pa nas/ rang gi nga rgyal bskyed la gnas dang gdan bskyed par bya'o// lcags kyu yi ni zhes bya ba la sogs pa la mdun du gzhal yas khang dang dkyil 'khor rnam par bsams pa'i steng du dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'ang spyan drang zhing*/ legs par bstod la zhes pa nas/ 'di ni bya ba'i rgyud kyi dbang du byas pa'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi cho ga sbyar gyi/ ting nge 'dzin gsum la sogs pa yo ga ji lta ba bzhin sbyar ba ni ma yin no// tshul 'di dang mthun pa'i sgrub thabs zur du byas pa ma mthong mod kyi/ rnam snang sgyu drwa'i le'u bdun pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon kun snying gis mdzad par rgyas par bshad pas der blta bar bya'o// gsum pa ni/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas bya spyod gnyis ka gcig tu bsdus nas nyams len gyi tshul 'dra bar bzhed de/ bsam gtan phyi ma'i 'grel par/ 'di'ang gsang sngags bzlas brjod byed pa'i bsam gtan gyi tshe na bya ba'i rgyud thams cad kyi spyi'i cho ga bsdus pa'i rgyud 'phags pa rab tu grub par byed pa dang*/ dpung bzang dang*/ dpal rtog pa bsdus pa la sogs pa dang*/ bye brag gi rgyud 'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pa'i byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rje mngon par dbang bskur ba dang*/ byang chub kyi snying po dang*/ rig 'dzin gyi sde snod la sogs pa las gsungs te/ kha cig tu ni mi mngon pa'i tshul du bshad/ kha cig tu gsal bar bstan te/ 'di ltar rab tu grub par byed pa las/ bzlas brjod byed pas bzlas brjod tshe// rig sngags lha nyid btang nas ni// sgom pa mchog tu gces pa yang*// rtog pa bzung nas yongs mi bsam// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so// de bzhin du dpung bzang las kyang*/

snyems dang bud med mi dger ldan pa'i sems// gang dang gang du kun tu rgyu ba dag /de dang de nas bsgrims te rnam bzlog nas// gsang sngags yi ge mchog la sbyar bar bya// zhes bya ba dang*/ de bzhin du/ bsam gtan dag dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa po// shes las byung ba dga' ba rab tu bskyed// dga' bas lus ni shin tu sbyangs pa thob// shin tu sbyangs sems bde bas skal ldan 'gyur// dga' bde yid gcig ting nge 'dzin gyur na// de tshe bzlas brjod dogs pa med par gyur// zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so// bdag gi de kho na nyid brtags pa'ang de nyid las gsungs te/ 'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs dri mar bcas// de bas sems ni 'khor ba yin par gsungs// nyon mongs rnam grol shel dang zla 'dra ba// srid pa'i rgya mtsho mthar ni kun tu bsgrags// zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gzhung gis bshad do// de bzhin du rnam par snang mdzad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa las kyang*/ bzlas brjod byed pa'i tshe/ bzlas brjod kyi yan lag bzhi'i sbyor bas gsang sngags kyi sbyor ba gsal ba nyid bshad do// phyag na rdo rje mngon par dbang bskur ba las kyang*/ 'jam dpal nam sngags pa lhun gyis grub par lha nyid kyis nga rgyal du gyur pa de'i gsang sngags thams cad mngon du phyogs par gnas par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// rig sngags 'chang gi sde snod las kyang*/ ri mo la sogs pa la gnas pa'i lha'i bsam gtan bya ba/ 'dis ni snyan cha kun tu bskyod// ne'u le rkyal pa bskul ba snyam// de ltar bzlas brjod 'bad pa'i tshe// zhabs la sogs pa'ang rim gyis brtag /ces gsungs pa dang*/ bdag gi de kho na nyid brtag pa'ang gnas pa gsum dang rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum la gzhol bar bya'o// zhes pa nas/ de bas na de la sogs pa'i rgyud du ji ltar srid pa'i lha'i gzugs dang*/ gsang sngags kyi sgra'i bsam gtan mngon du byas pa nyid kyis bzlas brjod gsungs so// gang dag tu gdul bya'i dbang gis ma bshad pa de dag ni rgyud thams cad kyi cho ga bsdus pa'i rgyud 'phags pa dpung bzang dang*/

dpal rtog pa bsdus pa la sogs pa las gsungs so// zhes bshad do// de la bya rgyud la bdag lha skur bskyed pa yod pa'i shes byed ni 'di rnams yin la/ rnam snang mngon byang dang phyag rdor dbang bskur gnyis ni spyod pa'i rgyud yin cing*/ legs grub dang dpung bzang gnyis bya rgyud yin kyang*/ dngos su bdag bskyed yod pa'i lugs mi snang la/ rtog bsdus ni bod na mi bzhugs kyang*/ yo ga'i 'grel pa a wa ta rar/ rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa 'grel pa las kyang*/ zhes rnal 'byor gyi rgyud du bshad pas/ de nas bdag bskyed bshad kyang shes byed du 'gro ba dka' zhing*/ rig sngags 'chang gi sde snod las/ ri mo la sogs pa la gnas pa'i zhes sogs kyi lung 'di ni ras bris la bsam gtan bya ba'i lung du snang ngo*// gang ltar yang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs su spyod rgyud ltar gyi nyams len bshad la/ de dang mthun par slob dpon byang chub snying po'i rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ shu raṃ ga warma'i rnam 'joms kyi dkyil chog rnams su'ang bshad la/ dze tā ri dang jo bo rje'i mi 'khrugs pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ ke la dha ra'i dam tshig gsum bkod kyi sgrub thabs rnams su'ang 'di dang tshul cung zad mi 'dra bar gsung mod/ 'di thams cad bya rgyud spyod rgyud dang mthun par bkral ba'i srol yin no// bzhi pa bya rgyud rang rkang ni/ rgyud sde gong mar 'jigs par dmigs shing shin tu gtsang sgra byed pa dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' bde ba dam pa med pa dang*/ bdag nyid lha'i snyems pa med pa dang*/ rmad du byung ba'i yul ma yin pa dang*/ skyon gyi rgyu'i rtog pa rab tu gcod pas bsgrub par bya ba'i rgyud la bzhugs so// zhes gsungs la/ de'i don ni/ gzhan gyis bkral ba rnams ni mi 'thad pa'i tshul sngar bshad zin la/

'dir rang lha'i skur bsgom pa la sogs pa nang gi bya ba la 'jigs par dmigs pa ste blta zhing*/ shin tu khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas par byed pa dang*/ gzhan nas spyan drangs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' rang la 'jug pa'i bde ba dam pa ste mchog med pa dang*/ bdag nyid lha'i sku zhal dang phyag gi rnam pa can gyis snyems pa ste nga rgyal bsgom pa med pa dang*/ rgyud sde gong mar bshad pa ltar gyi rmad du byung ba'i spyod yul la spyod pa ma yin pa'i tshul gyis phyi'i bya ba mang po sgrub par byed pa dang*/ skye rga la sogs pa 'khor ba'i rgud pa'i skyon dang*/ de'i rgyu'i rtsa ba ni dngos po la bden par 'dzin pa'i rtog pa ste/ de'i rang bzhin rab tu gcod pa ni so sor rtog pa'i shes rab bsgom pa ste/ de lta bu'i lam gyis sangs rgyas sgrub par byed pa ni bya ba'i rgyud rnams la bzhugs so// zhes bya ba yin no// des na gong rgyud sde bzhir phye ba'i ya gyal gyi bya ba'i rgyud yin na bdag nyid lha'i skur mi sgom pa sogs kyis khyab pas na bya ba'i rgyud la bdag lhar bsgom pa med do// zhes bya ba 'di ni rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyi bzhed pa'o// zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba'i tshul ni/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ chu dang cod pan gyi ni dbang*// bya ba'i rgyud la rab tu grags// rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang*// spyod pa'i rgyud la rab tu grags// phyir mi ldog pa yi ni dbang*// rnal 'byor rgyud du gsal bar byas// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ slob dpon a bha yā ka ra sogs paṇa grub mang pos kyang me tog phreng ba'i dbang dang*/ chu cod pan gyi dbang*/ mtha' brten dang bcas pa tsam gyis rgyud 'di nyid nyan pa dang*/ 'chad pa sogs las kun la dbang bar gsungs te/ slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis bya rgyud la slob dpon gyi dbang yod par gsungs pa'ang*/

lung bstan dbugs dbyung rjes gnang rnams la slob dpon gyi dbang du btags pa tsam yin no// des na 'dir bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bskur gang byed kyang*/ sngon du cho ga dang sta gon tshul bzhin byas la/ dkyil 'khor du bcug nas me tog phreng ba'i dbang dang*/ chu dbang*/ cod pan gyi dbang rnams rtsa ba yin la/ mtha' rten du lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung*/ rjes gnang dang bcas btags kyang rung ste des don grub pa nyid do// gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud la spyi'i don dang*/ dbang bskur tshul la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang nang sems kyi ting nge 'dzin gnyis ka cha mnyam par spyod pas spyod pa'i rgyud ces bya ste/ rnam snang mngon byang gi tshig 'grel las/ rgyud 'di'ang thabs dang shes rab gtso bor gyur pa'i spyod pa'i rgyud yin mod kyi/ bya ba la mos pa'i gdul bya'i 'gro ba rnams gzung ba'i phyir bya ba'i rjes su mthun pa'i spyod pa dag kyang ston pas bya ba'i rgyud dam/ gnyis ka'i rgyud lta bur so sor brtags shing grags so// zhes gsungs/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ pad+ma'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud de/ dang po ni/ rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa rnam par sprul pas byin gyis rlob pa zhes bya ba'i rtsa rgyud dang*/ de'i rgyud phyi ma gsang ba mchog gi rim par phye ba/ zhes bya ba dang*/ rigs kyi bdag por gtogs pa'ang ma dpal dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud bod du ma 'gyur zhing*/ rdo rje'i rigs la phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud sogs yod do// gnyis pa dbang ni/ sa'i cho ga sogs sta gon sngon du btang nas/ thun mong ba'i sdom pa byin cing*/ dkyil 'khor du bcug nas chu cod pan gyi dbang gi steng du/ rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang mtha' brten dang bcas pa bskur ba ni slob dpon snga ma dag gi bzhed pa rgyud dang 'byor pa kho na'o// gsum pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la spyi don dang*/

dbang bskur tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dang gsum las/ rnal 'byor rgyud thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni de nyid bsgrub pa yin la/ de'i gling gzhis thob bya don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i rnam snang bstan cing*/ de 'thob byed kyi thabs 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das kyi dngos grub sgrub tshul thun mong ba ni rtsa ba'i rgyud kyis ston/ de la dum bu bzhi las/ dang po rdor dbyings kyi dum bu las de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang*/ gnyis pa khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dum bu las rdo rje'i rigs dang*/ gsum pa 'gro 'dul gyi dum bu las pad+ma'i rigs dang*/ bzhi pa don grub kyi dum bu las rin po che'i rigs kyi dbang du byas pa'i lam rnams ston to// las kyi rigs ni rin po che'i rigs su bsdus par sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad do// rgyud phyi mas mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub tshul dang*/ phyi ma'i phyi mas bzlas pa dang mchod pa sogs phyi'i bya ba gtso bor ston cing*/ rgyud nye bar bsdus pas ma tshang ba kha bskang gi tshul du gsungs so// dum bu bzhi po re re las rgyas pa dang*/ 'bring dang*/ bsdus pa la dga' ba'i gdul bya gsum la dang po'i sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin gsum bsgom tshul rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gsum bstan/ rgyas pa'i ting nge 'dzin la dkyil 'khor chen po dang*/ gzungs dkyil dang*/ chos dkyil dang*/ las dkyil te bzhi/ 'bring gi ting nge 'dzin la rang rang gi phyag rgya bzhi/ bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin la rang rang gi phyag rgya gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin bstan to// gnyis pa bshad pa'i rgyud la/ rdo rje rtse mo 'phro ma tshang ba tsam 'gyur pas dngos su dkyil 'khor dgu ston pa/ dum bu dang po'i bshad rgyud thams cad gsang ba dkyil 'khor gcig ston pa dang*/ dum bu gnyis pa'i bshad rgyud 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtog pa/

rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor zhe drug ston pa rnams so// gsum pa cha mthun gyi rgyud la/ dpal mchog gi rgyud/ ngan song sbyong rgyud/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa/ gsang ba nor bu'i thig le/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ rab gnas kyi rgyud rnams so// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma dkyil 'khor du gzhug cing thun mong ba byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa sbyin/ ye shes pa dbab cing me tog dor bas lhag pa'i lhar nges par bya/ las bum gyi khrus sngon du 'gro ba'i chu dbang dang*/ cod pan gyi dbang*/ rdo rje'i dbang*/ dril bu'i dbang*/ ming gi dbang ste slob ma'i dbang lnga/ de'i steng du slob dpon gyi dbang la phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*/ gsang ba'i dbang*/ rjes gnang*/ lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung*/ gzengs bstod pa dang drug bsdoms pas dbang bskur bcu gcig sbyin par bya ba yin la/ 'di dag la dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa tsam zhig dang*/ zhugs pa la'ang rigs lnga'i sdom pa mi 'dzin zhing byang sdom rkyang pa 'dzin pa la slob ma'i dbang tsam bskur ba dang*/ sdom pa gnyis ka 'dzin par dbang rdzogs par bskur ba gnyis kyi rnam gzhag de nyid bsdus pa'i bstod 'grel du 'byung ngo*// gsang ba'i dbang zhes pa dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i 'jug pas zhugs shing mthong ba la dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de nyid dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid bcu dang las rim bstan pa la zer gyi/ bla med du bshad pa dang mi 'dra'o// yang yo ga 'ga' zhig tu shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhes pa'ang 'byung mod kyi/ sngags byin nas phyag rgya 'di la slob tu gzhug pa la ming tsam btags par zad do// yo ga dang bla med gnyis kar rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang la dam tshig gsum sbyin par mtshungs kyang*/ phyag rgya'i dam tshig gi skabs su bla med la/

brtag gnyis las/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// ces gsungs pa ltar yin zhing*/ 'di ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig lha sku phyag rgya chen po la byed pas/ slob ma rdo rje sems dpa'i skur sgom du 'jug pa tsam yin no// bzhi pa bla med la spyi'i don dang*/ dbang bskur tshul lo// dang po la/ bzhed tshul mang yang 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa dang*/ kun mkhyen bu ston sogs kyi bzhed pa ltar pha rgyud/ ma rgyud/ gnyis med gsum las/ dang po ni/ zla gsang thig le'i rgyud las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis// rgyud kyang rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po gdul bya 'dod chags can rjes su gzung ba'i ched du gsungs pa dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa/ de'i rgyud phyi ma rtsa rgyud le'u bco brgyad pa/ bshad rgyud dgongs pa lung ston le'u bcu gnyis pa/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba le'u re brgyad pa/ lha mo bzhis zhus le'u bzhi pa/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud le'u bcu bdun pa rnams la brten nas 'phags yul du 'dus pa srol chen bdun tsam 'byung ba'o// gnyis pa zhe sdang can rjes su gzung ba gshed skor la gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i rgyud/ dgra nag gi rgyud/ gdong drug gi rgyud/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa bdun pa/ rtog pa gsum pa/ dngos grub kyi rtog pa bcas la brten nas gshed skor gyi lugs srol mang du byung ba'o// gsum pa gti mug can rjes su gzung ba rnam snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud la brten nas 'phags yul du lugs srol du ma byung yang bod du ma 'gyur/ gnyis pa shes rab gtso bor ston pa rnal 'byor ma rgyud la/ sdom 'byung las/ de bzhin rnal 'byor ma rgyud grangs// bye ba phrag ni bcu drug go

/zhes ma rgyud dung phyur gcig dang bye ba drug yod par bshad pas/ de la'ang rigs drug cha mnyam du ston pa sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam par sbyor ba/ rigs so so'i rgyud la he ru ka'i rigs bde mchog sangs rgyas thod pa/ sgyu 'phrul chen mo/ a ra li sogs/ rnam snang gi rigs gdan bzhi dang*/ mi g.yo ba sogs/ rdo rje nyi ma'i rigs rdo rje bdud rtsi sogs/ pad+ma gar dbang gi rigs 'jig rten mgon po lnga bcu pa sogs/ rta mchog gi rigs sgrol ma mngon 'byung sogs/ rdo rje 'chang gi rigs ji bzhin brnyes pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud rnams la brten nas ma rgyud kyi bka' srol dar bar gyur to// gsum pa gnyis med rgyud la rgya che ba gnyis med kyi rgyud dus 'khor la rtsa ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa/ bsdus pa'i rgyud tshigs bcad stong sum cu bdag nyid can dang*/ zab pa'i gnyis su med pa dpal kye rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa dang*/ bshad pa'i rgyud thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje gur dang*/ thun mong ba sam+bu ṭa'i rgyud rnams la brten nas gnyis med kyi bka' srol rgya cher dar ro// gnyis pa dbang bskur tshul la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi rnam grangs/ dbang bskur ba'i tshul lo// dang po la bzhi/ rdul tshon/ ras bris/ bsam gtan/ lus dkyil lo// dang po ni/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas/ dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bar// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa ste// 'on kyang dkyil 'khor de'i rang bzhin// ci yin de ni 'di ltar bshad// ri mor bris pa'i las dang ni// thig las tshon dgye'i rim pa dang*// 'gro ba'i 'di dag rang bzhin gyis// grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o// zhes dbang bskur ba la dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa sngon du 'gro dgos shing*/ de la dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba sngon du gtong dgos pa'i thog mar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ni sa brtag pa/

sa bslang ba/ sa sbyang ba/ sa gzung ba/ sa bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab pa ste sa'i cho ga lnga legs par bya/ de nas sa'i lha mo lhag par gnas te gnang ba gsol/ lha sta gon gyi sgo nas dkyil 'khor 'bri bar 'gyur ba la byin gyis rlob pa'i don du gsol ba btab nas snyan gsan dbab/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bteg nas/ ye thig ma btab pa'i gong du'am/ lha sta gon zin pa'i de ma thag par bum pa sta gon tshul bzhin bya/ kun slong bcos pa la sogs pa'i chos bcu bzhi tshang bas slob ma sta gon bya/ ye thig btag ste/ rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor lhag chad dang nor 'khrul med par bris nas/ phyag rgya gsum gang yang rung ba dgod pa rnams sngon du gtang*/ dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i tshul la/ bdag mdun tha dad du byed pa dang*/ tha mi dad du byed pa'i lugs gnyis la/ grub chen dā ri ka pas bde mchog la bdag mdun tha dad du mdzad pa dang*/ dus 'khor la tha dad du byed pa yod kyi/ gzhan 'phags yul gyi chen po dag gi bzhed pa la bdag mdun tha mi dad du mdzad pa shin tu mang ngo*// tha dad du byed pa'i lugs ni sngon du bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa la 'jug pa na rang nyid mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin pa'i dmigs pa'ang mi byed/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal yang mi byed par mdun bskyed sgrub par byed pa yin no// tha mi dad du byed pa ni dang por bdag bskyed kyi mchod bstod bdud rtsi myong ba bzlas pa yan sngon du gtang*/ nyer bsdu mi byed par mdun bskyed la 'jug de'i tshe bdag gtso bo'i nga rgyal mi dgos par mdun bskyed bsgrubs zin pa na/ bdag bskyed kyi rten brten pa dang mdun bskyed kyi rten brten pa bsre bar byed pa la bdag mdun bsre ba'i tha snyad mdzad la/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nub dang por spyan drangs nas bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor la bstims pas nub phyi ma sogs la spyan drang rgyu med cing*/

de nas ye shes pa dgug gzhug dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab brtan byed kyi bzlas pa'i 'og tu rang nyid gtso bo las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du shar sgor bye nas mchod bstod dang bdag 'jug len pa sogs byed pa ste/ gang ltar yang mdun bskyed kyi mjug tu phyi rol du phyogs skyong bcu dang 'byung po rnams la gtor ma bsngo/ nang du 'ongs te dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing sgo dbye me tog dbul ba sogs byas nas/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang rdzogs par blangs te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la gtor ma dbul/ slob ma'i don du gsol ba gdab/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i slob ma lhag gnas sngon du song ba gcig nas nyer lnga'i bar zung du ma gyur pa dag la dbang bskur ba yin no// gnyis pa ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub pa'i tshul ni sa phyogs byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ bgegs bsrung ba sogs kyi don du gzung ba dang*/ bsrung zhing byin gyis rlob pa ni tshig ris cung zad bsgyur ba ma gtogs rdul tshon gyi skabs ltar bya dgos la/ sa brtag bslang gnyis mi dgos shing*/ sa lha dang lha sta gon sogs ni bya dgos pa dang*/ thig tshon gyi skor ma gtogs pa rdul tshon gyi skabs bzhin 'dor len shes pa'i sgo nas bsgrub par bya ba yin no// gsum pa bsam gtan gyi dkyil 'khor ni slob dpon ting nge 'dzin shin tu brtan pa dang*/ slob ma dbang rnon khyad par can la dmigs bsal du gsungs te/ bsgrub gzhi'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar dngos su sprul pa'am/ mos pas bskyed pa yin no// bzhi pa lus dkyil ni rang gi lus kyi cha so so gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin dang*/ rtsa khams rnams lha'i rang bzhin du grub pa gsal btab nas/ phyi dkyil gang yang rung bar dbang mtshan nyid dang ldan pas smin pa'i slob ma la gzhung ltar dbang sbyin pa'o// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba'i tshul la gnyis/

dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa dang*/ zhugs pa la dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ 'jug pa'i dus su dam tshig dang sdom pa bzung nas 'jug dgos pas/ de la thun mong ba byang sems dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa sngags sdom rigs lnga'i dam tshig rnams sngar med gsar du skye ba dang*/ nyams pa sor chud pa la dbang rdzogs par bskur ba dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas rigs lnga'i sdom gzung lan gsum bya dgos kyi/ mngon rtogs tsam bsgom pa dang*/ rjes gnang tsam gyis mi 'grub pas/ paṇa grub gong ma dag sdom gzung sta gon dngos gzhi gnyis kar byed pa dang*/ sta gon las dngos gzhir mi byed pa dang*/ dngos gzhi las sta gon gyi dus su mi byed pa ci rigs 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la bzhi las/ dang po bum pa'i dbang ni dbang gi bya ba slob dpon gyis dngos su mdzad kyang*/ skur byed dbang gi lha zur du spyan drangs pas dbang bskur gyi bya ba mdzad par mos/ bsgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor ba rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa gtad nas dbang gi bya ba mdzad par mos dgos pas na rdul tshon nam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du bum dbang thob par 'jog grangs ni 'dus pa'i lugs la bshad rgyud rdor phreng las/ dbang bskur re res re'o// zhes pa'i don bum dbang bcu gcig tu bshad pa sogs mi 'dra ba mang du snang zhing*/ de la'ang thun mong ba slob ma'i dbang dang*/ thun min rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rig pa ye shes lnga'i nus pa 'jog byed yin pas na rig pa'i dbang ste/ me tog phreng ba'i dbang gis rigs gang du nges pa dang*/ chu dbang gi rigs der 'tshang rgya ba la gegs byed kyi dri ma 'khrud pa dang*/ cod pan gyi dbang gis rigs bdag gang gis byed pa/ rdo rje'i dbang gis thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'grub pa/ dril bu'i dbang gis chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong ston pa'i gsung 'grub pa/

ming dbang gis sangs rgyas kyi mtshan 'grub pa rnams kyi nus pa 'jog cing*/ phung po lnga gnas 'gyur/ nyon mongs pa lnga sbyong ba sogs so so'i dag pa las shes par bya'o// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gis sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i rdo rje 'chang thob pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa dang*/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por dbang bskur bas rdo rje slob dpon gyi las thams cad la dbang ba'i nus pa 'jog pa'o// 'di rnams la bum pa'i chu'i bya ba rjes su 'gro bas na bum dbang zhes bya zhing*/ lus kyi mi dge ba gsum dang*/ lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i snang zhen gyi dri ma sbyong*/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i nus pa gzhag pa'o// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni slob dpon dang*/ las sam/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya gang yang rung ba la snyoms par zhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad zhu ba 'dus pa'i ngo bo khams dkar dmar 'dres pa la byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor zhes bshad pas/ de lta bu'i bdud rtsi nyid yab yum gyi mtheb srin gyis blangs te slob ma'i khar bzhag pas bde stong gi ye shes khyad par can skyes par mos pa des thun mong bdag gi dri ma rdzun smra ba sogs bzhi dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa rlung sngags so sor snang zhing zhen pa'i dri ma sbyong*/ ngag gi rtsa ba rlung byin gyis brlabs shing las su rung bar byas pas rdzogs rim gyi dben pa gsum dang*/ kun rdzob sgyu ma'i rdzogs rim bdag byin gyis rlob pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ lam dus su dhū tir rlung zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las stong pa bzhi skye ba dang*/ de'i stobs kyis rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i sgyu ma'i sku grub nas longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'gyur ba'i nus pa 'jog pa'o// gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/

mtshan nyid tshang ba'i pad+ma can sogs dngos kyi rig ma'am/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya gang yang rung ba'i bhā ga'i dkyil 'khor du rig ma dang 'du shes sum ldan gyis snyoms par zhugs pas dhū tir rlung rgyu ba la brten nas khams zhu ba spyi bo nas mgrin snying lte gsang gi bar du babs pas dga' ba bzhi skyes pas/ de dang stong pa nyid ro gcig tu zhugs pa'i lhan skyes bde stong gi ye shes de nyid sher dbang gi ngo bo ste/ des ni sbyang bya thun mong ba yid kyi dri ma brnabs sems sogs gsum dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gang snang bde stong gi ngo bor 'char ba la gegs byed kyi dri ma sbyong*/ de 'char ba'i nus pa dang*/ rim pa bzhi pa'i 'od gsal bsgom pa'i snod rung du byas/ 'bras bu zhu bde lhan skyes chos sku 'grub pa'i lag rjes 'jog pa yin no// bzhi pa tshig dbang ni dngos su da lta skye ba med kyang snod rung gis dbang bzhi par 'gyur ba ni dbang gsum pa mos pa tshun chad kyis nges pa'i tshe na de nyid dper byas te/ des mtshon pa'i zung 'jug gi go ba slob ma la brda sprad nas/ de la go ba chags shing de'i don la snyoms par 'jog pa la tshig dbang thob par 'jog la/ de'i tshul ni/ bzhi pa de yang de bzhin te// zhes pas dbang gsum pa'i dus su rang dang rig ma gnyis kyi lus 'dod lha yab yum yid ngor gsal bzhin pa'i ngang nas sems bde stong pa'i 'od gsal dus mnyam du 'byung ba bzhin/ lam dus su lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs mkhas kyi lam bsgoms pa la brtan nas rim pa bzhi pa'i mthar lus shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur dngos su song ba dang*/ de 'dra'i rgyun goms pa las 'bras bu de dang rnam pa mthun pa'i mi slob pa'i zung 'jug kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang sgrub tshul la nges shes bskyed pa tshig gi sgo nas gsal 'debs pa'o// de'ang don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/

'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ de nyid shes pas rim pa bzhin// rang byin rlabs dang 'od gsal shes// de dag kho na 'dus pa gang*// de ni zung 'jug rim pa'o// zhes bshad pa'i zung 'jug la go ba bskyed phyir tshig gis dbang bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa'i bag chags 'khrud pa dang*/ bden gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug gi rdzogs rim bsgom pa sogs la dbang*/ 'bras bu kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'i phan yon yod do// ༈ /gnyis pas byin rlabs ni bla med la grags che ste/ de dang dbang gi khyad par la rje btsun rin po ches/ byin rlabs phra mo tsam gyis ma yin te// sngags kyi rtsa ba dbang bskur yin pas so// zhes dang*/ rje sa paṇa gyis/ de phyir de ni byin rlabs tsam// yin gyi smin par byed pa min// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dbang ni phung khams skye mched la sku bzhi'i sa bon 'debs pa sogs smin grol gnyis kyi zlas phye ba'i smin byed mtshan nyid pa yin la/ byin rlabs ni dbang gis smin pa zhig la bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi ye shes skye ba'i sna 'dren du byed pa'i thabs khyad par can cig go /des na dbang spyi dang*/ byin rlabs de'i bye brag yin te/ snga ma ni rgyud ma smin pa smin par byed pa'am/ ma thob pa 'thob par byed pa'i cho ga yin pas rtsa ba lta bu dang*/ phyi ma ni smin zin nam/ thob zin gong 'phel du byed pa'i thabs yin pas yal ga lta bu ste/ dper na/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i byin rlabs/ bde mchog dril bu lus dkyil gyi byin rlabs/ gshed dmar spros med kyi byin rlabs/ bdag med ma dang mkha' spyod ma'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba sogs sngon du rang rang gi dkyil 'khor sta gon dang*/ dngos gzhis smin dgos pa'i gnad kyang de nyid do// gsum pa rjes gnang ni rgyud sde bzhi ga dang 'brel ba ste/

de'ang rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang gi cho ga rgyas pa yin phyin chad rjes gnang med pa mi srid cing*/ rjes gnang nyi tshe ba khol du phyung ba la ni dbang gi rnam gzhag ma mchis so// de la dbang gi zhar las byung ba rnams ni sgom bzlas dang las rab 'byams sgrub pa la sogs phal cher tshig tsam gyis sbyin pa rnams yin la/ khol phyung du byas pa rnams la de nyid kyi bya ba rgyas pa re 'byung ba ste/ gang ltar yang sgom bzlas 'di ltar gyis shig pa'i gnang ba sbyin pa tsam yin la/ gnang ba de'ang rdo rje 'chang nas bar ma chad du byin pa zhig dgos kyi/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi go 'phang brnyes pa yin kyang rang bzos sbyin du mi rung la/ gnang ba sbyin tshul la cho ga'i tshul gyis sbyin pa dang*/ lung 'bogs pa dang*/ tshig tsam gyis ster ba sogs ma nges pa mang ba las/ 'dir bshad kyi rjes gnang ni cho ga'i tshul gyis ster ba la ngos 'dzin dgos shing*/ de'i mtshan gzhi sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho la sogs pa'o// 'di la dkyil 'khor ma bshad pas mdun bskyed rten tshom bu dang mchod gtor tsam 'du byas la bdag mdun bskyed bzlas gtor ma dbul ba rnams song nas/ maṇ+ḍa

1 la/ gsol 2 gdab/ rgyun bsha 3 gas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ga 4 dab bzhi 'jug pa'i dod lta bu dang*/ gzhi 'god pa'i nang 'jug gi dod lta bu sngon du song nas/ de'ang rig sngags kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i gzhi lha bsgom dgos pas lhag pa'i lhar bskyed cing ye shes pa bstim pa yan sku'i rjes gnang*/ gsung gi rjes gnang la lung gsum las/ lha bsgom pa kho nas kyang dngos grub 'grub dka' bas/ de'i yan lag tu sngags bzla dgos pa'i phyir rjes su bzlas pa'i lung*/ sngags kyang bzlas brjod ma byas na lung 'bogs pa tsam gyis dngos grub mi 'grub pas bzlas brjod kyi don du dam bca' ba'i lung*/ de ltar sngags bzlas pas lo zla mang po'i mthar dngos grub 'grub kyang*/ bla ma dang lha'i byin rlabs kyi stobs kyis nyin zhag 'ga' tsam gyis dngos grub 'grub pa'i phyir byin gyis brlab pa'i lung*/ de lta bu'i lha bsgom sngags bzlas kyis thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad 'grub na'ang*/ mchog gi dngos grub mngon du byed pa la chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid rtogs dgos pas/ mdun bskyed ye shes kyi sku dngos dang*/ rigs 'dra gnyis pa bstims nas lha sngags kyis mtshon pa'i chos thams cad spros bral rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes su shes par byas nas de'i ngang la 'jog pa thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// mjug dam tshig khas bla 1 nga*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 2 / lus longs spyod 'bul 3 nas cha shas kyang longs spyod par gsol ba/ dge ba bsngo ba 4 'o// yang na gsol gdab/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i lha sku bsgom pa la ye shes pa bsre/ gsung bzlas lung*/ thugs phyag mtshan bstims nas de gsum gyis lha de dang de'i sku gsung thugs sgom bzlas la dbang ba tsam byas pa yin no// bzhi pa rig gtad ni gong smos ltar bya rgyud kyi dbang gi yan lag ste/ de la bya rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor phra mo mang po la sngags kyi dbang bskur ba zhes bum chu kho na'i dbang bskur tsam 'byung ba de nyid don la sngags gtad pa'am/

rig pa gtad pa yin te/ de'ang bya rgyud kyi lha'i cho ga bsdus pa'i rigs shig la sbyor ba'i tshe/ sngar dkyil 'khor du me tog phog pa'i lha'am/ gnas skabs der gang la mos pa'i lha de nyid kyi rig pa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing*/ rig sngags de nyid slob dpon gyis bzlas pa'i rjes su zlos pa dper mtshon na/ bi ma la'i lugs kyi gtsug tor gdugs dkar dang rnal 'joms dkar po/ gtsug tor dri med/ gsar 'gyur sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi cho ga la sogs pa rnams so// lung 'bogs pa 'di gnyis sngags gtad pa tsam mtshungs kyang*/ 'di la chu'i bya ba yod pas bya rgyud rang lugs su lha de'i phrin las sgrub nus slob dpon gyi skal pa 'jog cing*/ phyi ma la de med pas mchog dman gyi khyad par yod do// lnga pa lung 'bogs pa la sgom lung dang bzlas lung gnyis yod kyang*/ da lta sgom lung dbog phyin bzlas lung mi byed pa med la/ de'ang lung gang byed kyi lha de'i sgom bzlas tshar gcig slob dpon rang gis nyams su blang*/ slob ma'i bya ba maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug cing*/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rig sngags dam pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i gsol 'debs kyang spro na bya/ de nas sgrub thabs de'i dbu nas lung bklag pa ltar byed pa las/ khyad chos skyabs sems skabs rjes zlos/ sgom lung bzlas lung gnyis ka byed na mngon rtogs skabs slob ma nyid lhar gsal 'debs su gzhug cing*/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i skabs su'ang slob ma la bstim/ ye shes pa la mchod pa yod na dpon slob mnyam du bya/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi lung ji lta bar dmigs pa phog la bzlas pa rjes zlos mthar/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs dang*/ tshig lhug pa'i smon lam bya zhing me tog mgor gzhag sgrub thabs 'phros gang yod bklag lung bya ba ni cung zad rgyas pa'i phyogs yin la/ bsdu na slob mas maṇ+ḍal/

slob dpon gyis sgom tshul bshad/ phreng ba la 'jus te sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum mthar/ me tog spyi bor bzhag cing*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod/ rjes maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba tsam gyis don grub pa yin cing*/ gtso che chung gi ngos nas snga ma la sgom lung dang*/ phyi ma la bzlas lung gi tha snyad byas na'ang chog go /lung 'bogs pa'ang spyir rgyud sde bzhi ka'i yan lag tu yod pa gang la sbyor yang rung la/ bye brag bya rgyud nas bshad pa'i sgrub thabs rnams la ni logs su sbyor ba'i rgyun da lta'i bar du bzhugs bzhin pa nyid do// de dag kyang dkyil 'khor chen po gang yang rung ba zhig tu dbang bskur tshad ldan ma thob par sbyin du mi rung ste/ dper na bde mchog 'khor los dbang gi rgyud smin pa zhig la rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs bya ba dang*/ rgyud sde tshad ldan gang yang rung ba'i dbang thob pa zhig la rjes gnang la sogs pa bya ba yin cing*/ dbang bskur ma thob par khol phyung gi rjes gnang sogs byas pas ni slob ma la skabs der de tsam gyi sgom bzlas rung ba'i sa bon bzhag pa gong du smos pa ltar yin kyang*/ slob dpon rtogs pa dang mi ldan na gsang sgrogs kyi nyes par 'gyur ro// 'phags yul pa'i rnam thar du sgom lung tsam zhus nas bsgrubs pas grub par bshad pa ni mtshan nyid dang skal bar ldan pa'i dpon slob dmigs su bsal ba'o// spyir dbang bskur thob pas kyang sgos su lha dmigs bsal ba'i rjes gnang la sogs pa ni nod dgos te/ de ltar ma byas par sgom bzlas la 'jug na gsang sngags rang nyid kyis blangs pa'i nyes par 'gyur ro// chos skyong phal mo che la phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba sogs 'byung yang de ni de dang de'i las nyi tshe ba sgrub par rjes su gnang ba yin pas/ dbang gi skabs su slob dpon gyi las rab 'byams sgrub par gnang ba dang mi 'dra zhing khyad par che'o// 'khrul med sa skya'i rje btsun lugs bzhin du// dbang byin la sogs rnam dbye mdor bsdus su// bkod pa'i dge bas bdag sogs 'gro ba kun// nye rgyu'i mtshams sbyor dbang mchog thob par shog

/ces chos 'chad nyan bya tshul dang*/ dbang bskur rjes gnang sna tshogs kyi rnam dbye blo dman nyams dga' zhes bya ba 'di'ang rje rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de nyid kyi bzhed skong du blo gter dbang pos rang lugs kyi yig cha rnams la brten nas bris pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ /dbang dang rjes gnang gi skabs su phyag len gyi khyad par zin bris su bkod par bzhugs so// swa sti/ dbang rjes gnang gi phyag len zin bris su bkod par/ gong dkar ba'i lugs la rnal 'byor rgyud kyi sgrub pa'i lha 'god dus slob ma gral mgo ma de la/ sngags dang bcas phyag rgya gnas su reg pa dang*/ lha de'i mngon rtogs brjod nas 'bebs pa'i bar gsal 'debs/ slob ma bying la/ dmigs pa de bzhin gyis zhes brda sprod tsam byas nas 'jog pa yod/ zhwa lu ba sngags rgyas thams cad la reg tshar ba dang*/ gnas so sor lha gsal 'debs mdzad par snang ngo*// chu dbang la gong dkar ba dung chos gcig nas gcig tu sngags 'don gyin blug sngags tshar ba dang dung chos su blugs pa des slob ma la dbang bskur zer/ zhwa lu pa slob ma tshan rang bcad de bum pa so sor thogs nas slob ma'i lag pa rang rigs kyi khu tshur du slob dpon rang rigs kyi khu tshur gyis ku sha bzung nas ster/ las kyi rdo rjes rnam rgyal dung chos thogs nas brtan byed mdzad pa yod do// lung dang khrid spyir btang tsam la zhwa lu ba dang tshar lugs pa me tog bkye bsdu mi byed/ mgor maṇ+ḍal gcig phul nas chos grol ba dang bsngo ba ma gtogs gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal yang mdzad pa med/ gong dkar pa ni/ lung khrid la yang me tog bkye bsdu byed/ maṇ+ḍal snga ma langs nas 'bul/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal bsdangs nas 'bul ba yod/ sta gon gyi srung skud la sa skya pa dang ngor pa lha sta gon gyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu spyan drangs nas bstim/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas nas dpung pa la 'ching*/

zhwa lu ba bsang sbyang skyed gsum byas nas bud+dha mai tri'i sngags las yig brgyas 'ching ba ma mthong*/ sa skya pa dang dge lugs pa so shing gcig 'thus byed/ zhwa lu pa re re bzhin so shing brims nas byed pa yod/ sa ngor gnyis khyor chu yang dung chos nas tshar gsum re ster 'thung du 'jug zhwa lu pa 'khyor chu blug thengs gcig byas nas sngub gsum bcad nas lhag ma rgyab la 'bo dgos so zer/ dge lugs pa phal cher slob ma'i gtso bo re tsam las ma gtogs dbang rdzas 'di dag slob dpon gyis chos g.yog la bskur nas skyel ba'i lag len sgrob shin tu che'o// yang sa ngor du kye rdor gyi rgyu dbang dang lam dbang sogs kyi skabs sbyang ba la mchod stegs khar g.yas su chu dang g.yon du me/ de'i mdun du gral rim bzhin chu bzhi bzed zhal gcig bshams/ thog mar ni ri ti sogs la chu bzhi bzed zhal du blug de nas yungs kar lag pa g.yas dang g.yon pad kor 'khyud rgyas me chur dor/ de la sngags aṣ+ṭa bzla bar 'dug de bzhin du chu yang dor/ lan gsum gsum mdzad/ bkra shis skabs mchod g.yog pas bum pa 'degs/ slob dpon gyis dril gsil me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis brjod/ rgyun du bum pa la stegs khebs g.yogs nas 'jog lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang la sgeg mo dang phreng ba ma zhwa lu pa dang 'dra/ glu ma la mdzub mo gnyis bsgrengs pa rtse sprod/ gar ma la thal mo spyi bor 'jog me tog ma la thal mo steng ma gyen du 'thor tshul/ dri ma la thal mo g.yas khu tshur g.yon steng byug pa'i tshul byed/ rigs lnga la phyag chen byed/ dbang la mchod pa drug dang*/ gzhan kha gso/ gral mgo nas rim bzhin gral mtha' bar chos g.yog gis spos nas 'jog bum dbang gi slob dpon dbang gi mchod pa tshar 'phral dbang rdzas/ dbu rgyan/ rdo dril rnams bsdu/ dbang bzhi pa'i gtso bos ji ltar la mig dar yang bsdu/ dam bzhag la dril bu mi gsil/

rdo rje rkyang pa/ rigs lnga la dar dpyangs kyang mi 'jog/ ༈ /yang rjes gnang mang po sbrel nas gnang pa'i phyag len la bkras lhun shar zur rje ni mchod stegs khar shong tshad tshang ma gral bsgrig thams cad dus gcig la sgrub/ slob ma tshogs nas sher snying dang zlog pa rgyab/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba tshar nas bgegs gtor bsngo/ de rjes rjes gnang gcig rjes gcig mthud kyis thams cad mdzad par snang ngo*// ༈ /sa ngor zhwa lu pa sogs rjes gnang snga ma tshar ba dang gzhan rnams grol/ mchod g.yog pas de'i bar la bsham bsdu bkod byas nas yang bsgrubs tshar ba dang*/ slob ma tshogs pa sogs re re bzhin las sgril nas mi mdzad/ bsgrub rgyu mang po med pa dang*/ slob ma tshogs grol rin mi chog pa'i tshan yin na bar du yol bas bcad/ slob mas de'i bar la sgrol ma lta bu lha de'i bstod pa 'don pa phyag len no// sa ngor/ zhwa lu pa/ bgegs sbyong bshad pa'i rigs la ma gtogs bgegs gtor bsngo ba mi mdzad/ nang tshan zhwa lu pa dkyil 'khor yod sar bgegs gtor mi gtong*/ gal te bsngo na sgrub khang gi phyi rol du phyin nas gtong*/ nang du 'jug pa'i tshe bsang chus gtor/ spos kyis bdug pa sogs ma byas par nang du mi 'ong ba sogs cho ga'i dam tshig tu 'dod do// dge lugs pa dbang rjes gnang gi rigs thams cad la bsngo ba yod/ lar sa zhal dgongs pa mthun par srung 'khor gyi nang du bgegs rigs 'byung po mi tshud pas bgegs gtor phal cher de'i phyi rol du phyin nas btang ba'i go ba tshol ba 'dra'o// maṇ+ḍal 'bul tshul/ sa ngor la mchod g.yog pas bsdad nas tshom bu bso ba tsam byed pa las gzhan med/ zhwa lu pa slob ma'i gtso bo gcig dang*/ mchod g.yog pa gnyis langs nas mchod g.yogs pas 'bru snod btegs/ gtso bos maṇ+ḍal bskul zhing tshom bu bkod/ 'bul ba'i tshe gzhi bca' dang bcas pa'i gar stabs/ pus mo g.yon 'dzugs/ bla mas 'bru phud blangs te i daṃ gu ru brjod nas gtor/

skyong skyong der 'bru gsar pa blugs pa phyag len yin yang da lta byed shes mi shes sna tshogs 'dug bka' brgyud pa dang rnying ma ba ni maṇ+ḍal langs nas bsang sbyang byas te 'bul/ gar stabs sogs mi byed/ me tog phreng ba gos chen tshon sna lnga pa la bzos nas ster/ de dbang tshar ba dang sgom thag la sbyar nas tshem bu byed pa 'dug 'khrid gnang dus sngon la khrid dpe nas bsgrags/ de rjes de nang bzhin bshad pa re byed/ gsum bshad dang bzhi bshad sogs kyi tha snyad bka' brgyud pa dang dge lugs pa sogs la mi 'dug go /de ltar chos sgo sna tshogs tshol ba'i dus// ma 'dres gtsang ba'i phyag len phra zhib kyis// yid la bzung ba'i rnam thar zur tsam 'di// slad nas byon pa'i shes ldan rnams kyis longs// phyogs rer zhen pa'i grub mtha'i gtsang khyad kyis// gzhan lugs zur zas smod pa'i chos spongs las// nyam chung bdag gi khur du ma 'tshams par// dag snang phyogs med byas nas chos btsal lo// mang du nyan nas mang du bsgoms// don gnyer can la bshad kyang bshad// de 'dras mi tshe rgas pa 'di// a bsod che ba'i lag rjes yin// zhes pa blo gsal ri khrod pas smras pa'o// //dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
